observation_time_note: Clock read immediately before the three read-only connector fetches; ages are measured at this sampling start.

publication.timestamp_limit: Commit and published index generation timestamps are inspected values, not independently measured push receipt or per-course provider observation timestamps.

index_declared_coverage.verification_limit: Coverage is stated by this index only. No tree listing or other payload body was inspected, so all-file presence and whole-cache health are unverified in this sample.

signature_definitions.clear_all_zero: label == Clear and numeric tmax, tmin, rain_chance, rain_mm, wind all equal 0
signature_definitions.zero_temperature_and_wind: numeric tmax, tmin, wind all equal 0

sampled_payload.limits: Counts apply only to this one 37-record current-date 18-hole payload; cached rows are not verified live booking availability. No claims about other dates, 9-hole payloads, all 56 declared payloads, native UI, or notification delivery.

other_triggers: main push restricted to refresh workflow and scripts paths
completed Check preferred-date alerts workflow_run on main, additionally gated to upstream workflow_dispatch from same repository
source_schedule.interpretation: The source configures ten-minute scheduled opportunities; one pinned commit/index/payload sample cannot establish actual successive cadence, run latency, freshness between samples, or whether this publication came from the schedule or another configured trigger.

inference.reasoning: No truthy error, stale fallback, or defined false-zero weather signature appears in the one selected payload. This does not resolve known provider/weather defects on other dates or supersede existing repair drafts.

retained_limit.exact_action: GitHub connector read of production workflow run history
retained_limit.reason: HTTP 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT: endpoint not on connector allow-list
retained_limit.consequence: No production-run history or latency verification; configured source schedule and actual pinned publication/payload timestamps are reported separately.
